claims.subject: katsumasa

evidence.quote: As Katsumasa led her through a maze of passages, Kotori's skin crackled with exhilaration.
Across Otawara, his name was spoken with hushed reverence: Katsumasa, the Animator, puppeteer of the mechs, engineer of the future.

claims.summary: Katsumasa, the Animator, leads Kotori into his workshop.
claims.limitation: A guiding role is shown; a formal mentorship is inferred.

claims.subject: heiko

evidence.quote: Norika puts every ounce of authority she can muster into her ten-year-old voice and, as always, it has zero effect on her cousin.

And though Norika understands well her responsibilities as the elder cousin, the eldest daughter of the Yamazaki household, the more Heiko pesters her, the more she has to admit—she wants to see the merge, too.

claims.summary: Norika and Heiko are cousins; Norika is the elder.
